description: Find members and ministers by name, family-name prefix, party, committee, constituency and service status. Defaults to the service register; register all includes earlier source records through a larger cold request that may time out unless committee or familyNamePrefix narrows it. A committee returns its current holders with their current roles. Use numeric memberId with riksdag_get_member for assignment history.

committee.description: Committee code or exact reference label; returns its current holders in either register, each with committeeAssignments current at the source time.

constituency.description: Exact constituency reference label or code, applied locally.

familyNamePrefix.description: Family-name prefix matched by the source in either register: the start of its sort name (Family,Given, so von Sydow sorts as Sydow), ignoring case but not accents, with V and W treated alike. Cannot contain %, _ or a comma.

nameContains.description: Strict all-token local name filter, ignoring case and diacritics.

party.description: Party code or exact reference label.

register.description: Register scope; all includes historical records, and a cold request without committee or familyNamePrefix can reach the normal timeout.

revision.description: Revision returned by a preceding page.

sitting.description: Source service classification; all retains unknown status.

name: riksdag_search_members

candidateCount.description: Returned candidate records in the selected register scope.

effectiveQuery.description: Normalized input, defaults and local filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Unknown party, committee or constituency code, punctuation-only nameContains, or a familyNamePrefix containing %, _ or a comma. `revision_changed`: Revision no longer matches. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Source rows contradict the required identity. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Source unavailable after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: Complete-list safety limit reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

committeeAssignments.description: Assignments in the requested committee whose interval contains the source time, in source order; a date-only end counts through that day. Present only with committee.

from.description: Source start date or timestamp, without inferred timezone.

to.description: Source end date or timestamp; not proof of current service.

detailAvailable.description: Whether a numeric member IID is published for riksdag_get_member.

memberId.description: Numeric register IID, including leading zeros; absent for some historical and European Parliament entries.

name.description: Published given and family names, when present.

serviceClassification.description: Source-defined Swedish chamber service; unknown is retained.

sourceRecordId.description: Source register UUID, distinct from the member IID.

args.description: Complete normalized arguments for riksdag_search_members, valid against its input schema; pass back unchanged.

items.description: A limitation, applied bound or next-step notice.

retrievedAt.description: Source fetch time; unchanged on cache hits.

source.description: Required attribution to the Swedish Parliament.

sourceReportedCount.description: Source-reported hits; can differ from returned candidates in all scope.

upstreamQuery.description: Upstream query echo, not proof a filter applied.

title: Search parliamentary members
